summary:
Fixed direct check (action=check) for unit-claim-heartbeat-header-gate, preflight-validated with valid=True and no diagnostics.

Design: plan_c2.json plus harness_hbgate_test.go build three Raft nodes with all background goroutines disabled (conf.skipStartup, the package's own test pattern), declare one out-of-window pure heartbeat (node ProtocolVersionMax=3, request header version 0, which checkRPCHeader rejects because 0 < 3-1), and drive that same request through both AppendEntries entry paths — processRPC (normal, gated) and processHeartbeat (the body of the handler installed by SetHeartbeatHandler, ungated) — with an in-window control on the normal path. Prerequisites: alias scenario (out_of_window_protocol_version true) and alias normal-rejected (rejected true, state_changed false). Monitor applicability: out_of_window_protocol_version true, admission alias normal-rejected. Property: assertion that guard_applied is true on the fast-path result event, identity op_id — i.e. term, state, leader identity and last contact unchanged. The oracle reads emitted event fields, not tests_passed.

Construction evidence (not the formal observation): running the harness locally in a copy of the captured module passes with normal path 'operation not supported with current protocol version' and no state change, fast path term 0 to 5, leader adopted as ghost-leader, last contact refreshed, guard_applied false, and the in-window control accepted — showing the difference is attributable to the header window rather than the request shape. gofmt and go vet are clean against the actual package.

Declared semantic adaptations: processHeartbeat is invoked directly because it is exactly the callback body (the library's own integration test calls r.processHeartbeat(rpc) from inside a custom heartbeat handler) and net_transport's fast path is TCP-only while the sandbox has network disabled; the transport's heartbeat classification is a sourced premise, not reproduced.

Retained uncertainties, not assumed away: whether an out-of-window peer can deliver a pure heartbeat in a legal deployment, whether the omission is deliberate design (which would make the correct disposition a documented assumption rather than a violation), and the unmeasured election consequence of refreshing last contact on this path.
